message: Turn 40 fixed at 643b72a05fd73dacb7ebeff57a5ec869cc0a98a8, Dispatcher 2.2.12. Changed files: .agent-handoff/dispatcher.py, .agent-handoff/dispatcher-runtime.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_bootstrap.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_page.py, .agent-handoff/test_control_restore.py, .agent-handoff/test_signal_fetch.py. Installer unchanged and still version-dynamic. Tests: python3 -m py_compile dispatcher.py dispatcher-runtime.py test_control_bootstrap.py test_control_page.py test_control_restore.py test_signal_fetch.py exit 0; python3 test_control_restore.py printed test_control_restore: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_page.py printed test_control_page: OK, exit 0; python3 test_control_bootstrap.py printed test_control_bootstrap: OK and inferTurnRole: OK, exit 0; python3 test_signal_fetch.py printed test_signal_fetch: OK, exit 0. Restore semantics: a saved /c/WEB:<uuid> is restored by trying https://chatgpt.com/c/<uuid> first, then the saved WEB alias. A non-WEB URL has only itself as a candidate. The attempt uses one marked page. After each goto, a wait of at most 6 seconds inspects the observed URL, messages, and composer. The page is accepted when the observed URL has the same conversation identity or positive control identity is visible, even if the composer is not ready. Acceptance writes the observed URL in one replace and preserves bootstrap_sent_at, recovery_used, recovery_reason, and recovered_from. A failed pass records restore_attempted_at and does not open another page. During the 60-second cooldown an existing restore page is reused without goto, and a missing page waits instead of being recreated. An unrelated ChatGPT conversation is never navigated. Bootstrap is not resent and recovery_used is not reset. Once the restored page is usable, the pending wake is sent once under the existing de-duplication. CHECK_INTERVAL stays 5. The 2.2.10 raw-to-api failover is unchanged. Logs contain page and candidate tokens only, not message text. main and arena/local-agent-v0 were not modified. Phase 2 and live mailbox were not enabled.
